race.description: Rmbl Investments Rising Stars Race Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: AUBAINE (1) broke through for a dominant maiden win at Ballarat Synthetic last time out, going to the front and giving nothing else a look, scoring by 3.5 lengths. Has to convert that to turf but will get good ground and every chance from an ideal draw. SAVANNAH CHILL (3) just found one better here last start over this trip, running on well to get within half a length. She'll be hard to hold out again. SUPER MIRAGE (2) resumes. He got over further last time in but this looks a lovely kick-off point. He's jumped out quite well and looks a good hope. LOVE SPARKLES (5) is going okay and has each-way claims.
